verses.text: Hallelujah! Yes, praise the Lord! Praise him in his Temple and in the heavens he made with mighty power.

footnotes.text: in the heavens he made with mighty power, literally, “in the firmament of his power.”

verses.text: Praise him for his mighty works. Praise his unequaled greatness.
Praise him with the trumpet and with lute and harp.
Praise him with the drums and dancing. Praise him with stringed instruments and horns.
Praise him with the cymbals, yes, loud clanging cymbals.
Let everything alive give praises to the Lord! You praise him! Hallelujah!
